about: The communio of the formulary “Easter Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed, alleluia. So let us feast with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

alignments.gloss: Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed

w003.explanation: Christus is the subject. Pascha nostrum identifies Him as our Passover, and immolatus est means “has been sacrificed”.
